hebrewText: בִּֽ/ימִינ֞/וֹ הָיָ֣ה הַ/קֶּ֣סֶם יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם לָ/שׂ֤וּם כָּרִים֙ לִ/פְתֹּ֤חַ פֶּה֙ בְּ/רֶ֔צַח לְ/הָרִ֥ים ק֖וֹל בִּ/תְרוּעָ֑ה לָ/שׂ֤וּם כָּרִים֙ עַל שְׁעָרִ֔ים לִ/שְׁפֹּ֥ךְ סֹלְלָ֖ה לִ/בְנ֥וֹת דָּיֵֽק

tokens.bdb: the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south
tokens.kjv: [phrase] left-handed, right (hand, side), south.

tokens.bdb: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
tokens.kjv: beacon, [idiom] altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, [phrase] follow, happen, [idiom] have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, [idiom] use.

tokens.bdb: a lot; also divination (including its fee), oracle
tokens.kjv: (reward of) divination, divine sentence, witchcraft.

tokens.bdb: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
tokens.kjv: Jerusalem.

tokens.bdb: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring, call (a name), care, cast in, change, charge, commit, consider, convey, determine, [phrase] disguise, dispose, do, get, give, heap up, hold, impute, lay (down, up), leave, look, make (out), mark, [phrase] name, [idiom] on, ordain, order, [phrase] paint, place, preserve, purpose, put (on), [phrase] regard, rehearse, reward, (cause to) set (on, up), shew, [phrase] stedfastly, take, [idiom] tell, [phrase] tread down, (over-)turn, [idiom] wholly, work.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.enLiteralWord: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanation: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanationEn: to put (used in a great variety of applications

tokens.bdb: a ram (as full-grown and fat), including a battering-ram (as butting); hence, a meadow (as for sheep); also a pad or camel's saddle (as puffed out)
tokens.kjv: captain, furniture, lamb, (large) pasture, ram. See also H1033 (בֵּית כַּר), H3746 (כָּרִי).

tokens.bdb: to open wide (literally or figuratively); specifically, to loosen, begin, plough, carve
tokens.kjv: appear, break forth, draw (out), let go free, (en-) grave(-n), loose (self), (be, be set) open(-ing), put off, ungird, unstop, have vent.

tokens.bdb: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
tokens.kjv: accord(-ing as, -ing to), after, appointment, assent, collar, command(-ment), [idiom] eat, edge, end, entry, [phrase] file, hole, [idiom] in, mind, mouth, part, portion, [idiom] (should) say(-ing), sentence, skirt, sound, speech, [idiom] spoken, talk, tenor, [idiom] to, [phrase] two-edged, wish, word.
tokens.explanation: peh — boca, linguagem, beira, entrada, abertura

tokens.bdb: a crushing; specifically, a murder-cry
tokens.kjv: slaughter, sword.

tokens.bdb: to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: bring up, exalt (self), extol, give, go up, haughty, heave (up), (be, lift up on, make on, set up on, too) high(-er, one), hold up, levy, lift(-er) up, (be) lofty, ([idiom] a-) loud, mount up, offer (up), [phrase] presumptuously, (be) promote(-ion), proud, set up, tall(-er), take (away, off, up), breed worms.

tokens.bdb: a voice or sound
tokens.kjv: [phrase] aloud, bleating, crackling, cry ([phrase] out), fame, lightness, lowing, noise, [phrase] hold peace, (pro-) claim, proclamation, [phrase] sing, sound, [phrase] spark, thunder(-ing), voice, [phrase] yell.

tokens.bdb: clamor, i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry; especially clangorof trumpets, as an alarum
tokens.kjv: alarm, blow(-ing) (of, the) (trumpets), joy, jubile, loud noise, rejoicing, shout(-ing), (high, joyful) sound(-ing).

tokens.bdb: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring, call (a name), care, cast in, change, charge, commit, consider, convey, determine, [phrase] disguise, dispose, do, get, give, heap up, hold, impute, lay (down, up), leave, look, make (out), mark, [phrase] name, [idiom] on, ordain, order, [phrase] paint, place, preserve, purpose, put (on), [phrase] regard, rehearse, reward, (cause to) set (on, up), shew, [phrase] stedfastly, take, [idiom] tell, [phrase] tread down, (over-)turn, [idiom] wholly, work.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.enLiteralWord: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanation: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanationEn: to put (used in a great variety of applications

tokens.bdb: a ram (as full-grown and fat), including a battering-ram (as butting); hence, a meadow (as for sheep); also a pad or camel's saddle (as puffed out)
tokens.kjv: captain, furniture, lamb, (large) pasture, ram. See also H1033 (בֵּית כַּר), H3746 (כָּרִי).

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: an opening, i.e. door or gate
tokens.kjv: city, door, gate, port ([idiom] -er).

tokens.bdb: to spill forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, i.e. to mound up); also (figuratively) to expend (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively, to sprawl out
tokens.kjv: cast (up), gush out, pour (out), shed(-der, out), slip.

tokens.bdb: a military mound, i.e. rampart of besiegers
tokens.kjv: bank, mount.

tokens.bdb: to build (literally and figuratively)
tokens.kjv: (begin to) build(-er), obtain children, make, repair, set (up), [idiom] surely.

tokens.bdb: a battering-tower
tokens.kjv: fort.
